protocol: Fixed current candidate plus optional micro-move add-ons. Add-ons use M1/M5/M15/H1 continuation or pullback price action, RSI/flow and Bollinger/local-level confirmation, pending stop orders, 1R-3R targets and broker-like trailing. Selection requires higher development profit than the fixed baseline and improvement in at least two of three chronological folds; holdout is untouched until final evaluation.
